name: notify_employee
description:
Alert the human queue that a ticket is waiting. SIMULATED: recorded, nobody is contacted.

The ticket must be the customer's, from create_handoff in this scenario. A ticket
already notified returns that notification's receipt. Confirm with read_notification.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key; a retry with the same key returns the same receipt.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

output_schema.description: What a write returns: only the id. The agent proves the effect with read_*.
output_schema.title: ActionReceipt
